plugin.trust.unknown_publisher: %s is signed by a publisher this machine does not trust yet.
plugin.trust.verify_hint: Compare this fingerprint with the one the publisher announces (release page, internal portal) before trusting it.
plugin.trust.confirm: Trust this publisher for this plugin and its future updates? [y/N]
plugin.install.publisher_trusted: Publisher %s trusted and pinned for this plugin.
plugin.install.local_sign_failed: Built, but signing with the local machine key failed: %v
plugin.install.local_signed: Signed with this machine's local key (it loads with signature enforcement on).
plugincli.trust.list.empty: No trusted keys. Install a signed plugin, or ask your administrator for managed keys.
plugin.install.refused_unsigned: %s is unsigned. Install a signed build, or allow unsigned plugins with CHATCLI_ALLOW_UNSIGNED_PLUGINS=true (development only).
plugin.install.refused_bad_signature: The signature of %s does not match its bundled key or any trusted key: the binary or the signature was altered. Nothing was installed.
plugin.install.refused_key_changed: %s was installed from publisher %s, but this bundle is signed by %s. Nothing was installed. If the publisher really rotated its key, uninstall the plugin and install it again to trust the new key.
plugin.install.refused_trust_mismatch: --trust %s does not match the publisher that signed the bundle (%s). Nothing was installed.
plugin.install.refused_no_bundled_key: %s is signed by a key this machine does not trust, and the bundle carries no publisher key (<binary>.pub) to trust.
plugin.install.refused_not_trusted: %s is signed by %s, a publisher this machine does not trust yet. Confirm it in an interactive terminal, or pass --trust %s.
